purpose: TASK-F02 follow-up: native JSON-object state vs the shipped dict-repr string, both with the UNCHANGED single is_threat question, under Tier-1 steering payloads. Evidence only; no production change.
key_loading: The TypeSafe API key environment variable was read from the maintainer's main-checkout .env via python-dotenv dotenv_values and passed to the child process environment only; no credential value or variable name is in any artifact or log.

method.corpus: Current TASK-F09 balanced corpus via jev_tier2_eval.load_cases(release, 'current') (no [[VALUE]] placeholders); 20 malicious + 20 benign bases per dev pass, 10 per class for the one-pass heldout check, sorted by id.
method.payloads: 22 dev + 22 heldout payloads from jev_tier2_eval.tier1_payloads(), each attached via apply_steering() to a copy of the base case; unsteered baseline row per base.
method.arms: legacy = JevTriageBackend.build_legacy_state (shipped dict-repr string); structured = build_state (G01 native JSON object). Both send exactly {model,state,questions} with the SINGLE shipped is_threat noul and the 0.08/0.40 band; no question redesign (G04 rejected the atomic arm).
method.passes: dev: passes 1/2 interleaved by arm; heldout: pass 3, one-pass check with different payload text. Named jev-1.14.0, no alias; served_model checked on every row.
method.metrics: From committed rows only: below-edge crossings = steered malicious calls scoring <0.08 on bases whose unsteered score was clear_high; benign clear-high rate and mean benign P shift vs that base's unsteered score. Tier-1 signals only — no Tier-2 verdicts, so to-ALLOW flips are NOT measured.
method.decision_rule: Fixed before pinning (in tests/unit/test_jev_f02_structured_state_data.py): structured must not increase below-edge crossings, must keep malicious clear-high within 0.025 of legacy, and must improve benign clear-high by >=0.02 and benign P shift by >=0.01, on both dev passes and heldout.
method.discarded_note: No run discarded: all 6 arms/passes completed with zero errors and served jev-1.14.0 on every row.

decision.rationale: SIGNAL SUPPORTED FOR THE BENIGN SIDE, NOT SHIPPABLE. On both dev passes and the heldout check the structured state reduced benign clear-high holds (21.1%->16.6%, 20.9%->17.3%, 24.5%->18.2%) and mean benign P shift (+0.170->+0.145, +0.169->+0.146, +0.182->+0.137) versus the shipped dict-repr state under the same steering payloads, while malicious clear-high stayed within 0.025 and below-edge crossings were 0 in both arms. The crossing phenomenon F02 measured earlier was NOT reproduced in this bounded Tier-1-only sample, so this is NOT evidence that structured state resists steering; it is evidence that it does not inflate the benign side (unlike nonce-XML 37.0%->56.2% and atomic+max FRR 0.89-1.00). No src change: a shipping decision needs a full Tier-1/Tier-2 defense validation with to-ALLOW flips and benign flags measured on matched populations, plus the same-change rule/config proposal.

caveats: Tier-1-only: no Tier-2 verdicts, so to-ALLOW flips and Tier-2 fire rate are unmeasured.
Below-edge crossings were zero in both arms on these bases; the experiment cannot validate a crossing reduction.
Bounded: 20 bases/class on dev (2 passes) and 10/class heldout (1 pass); single named release.
The heldout payloads are different text from dev but the same base-case pool prefix; the split is on payload text, not independently sampled cases.
